annotations.title: Check a booking in or out

description: Mark a session booking as checked in (checkedIn=true) or undo the check-in (checkedIn=false). Booking ids come from momence_list_session_bookings. Momence: POST / DELETE /api/v2/host/session-bookings/{bookingId}/check-in.

checkedIn.description: true to check in, false to undo the check-in.

name: momence_set_booking_check_in
